description: This Java interface defines actions related to sharing notes in an Android application, including permissions, sharing, unsharing, and link management.

classes.name: NoteShareItemAction
classes.description: An interface providing methods for managing note sharing actions such as permissions, sharing, unsharing, and link handling.

methods.name: advancedPermissions
methods.description: Open advanced permissions for the selected share.

methods.name: sendNewEmail
methods.description: Open the note screen to send a new email related to the share.

methods.name: unShare
methods.description: Unshare the current note or resource.

methods.name: sendLink
methods.description: Send a link to the shared resource; only valid for PUBLIC_LINK type.

methods.name: addAnotherLink
methods.description: Create an additional share link; only valid for PUBLIC_LINK type.
